title: video: independently analyze the response without the opposite auction side

source.name: IAB VAST_Samples repository — VAST 4.2 Samples/Inline_Linear_Tag-test.xml
source.license: IAB Tech Lab VAST_Samples repository; the repository LICENSE.txt is a disclaimer only, granting no explicit reuse right (see video-audio:va-sample-license) — treated as reference-only, structure/tag-set informed the fixture; all text content and hosts rewritten as original test data (MIT)
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All tracking, media, click and error hosts rewritten to *.example.test; the Ad id, AdServingId, AdTitle and MediaFile filenames are namespaced to this case id.
AdSystem text 'iabtechlab' replaced with the fixture label 'ortbtools test fixture'; AdTitle content set to this case's id so a rendered/inert-text check has a unique marker.

Extension total_available changed from the sample's 2 to 1, Pricing changed from 25.00 to 3.00 (matching bid.price) and the ClickThrough id attribute changed from 'blog' to 'offer'; these are the only content-value edits beyond hosts and labels.
The OpenRTB 2.6 BidRequest/BidResponse envelope around the VAST document is original test data; the VAST tag set, attribute names and nesting are otherwise unmodified from the IAB sample.
Request/response IDs and impid are intentionally paired.
No real person, cookie, advertising ID, IP address or live tracking endpoint is retained.
Remove the request from video-x-web-42-inline-linear; no auction relation may be invented from an absent side.
provenance.sanitized: No production payload or PII used. All resource and tracking hosts end in .test; external network must remain blocked.

pairApplicability.note: The opposite auction side is deliberately absent; validation remains meaningful and crosscheck must be empty.
